decisions.reason: Minimum quantity lubrication sits close to the firm's core machine-tool customer base and costs little to keep on a modular platform, and with no website evidence after 2019 its value is unresolved, so the option is still worth holding while sustainability-driven demand for dry machining may grow.

The hydrocyclone filter extends the firm's established coolant filtration line with low added carrying cost, and with no evidence that its value has failed, it remains a cheap option worth keeping while the firm expands.

The gravity band filter is a standard, close-to-core filtration product that fits the one-stop modular offering, so keeping it costs little and nothing indicates its prospects have resolved negatively.
